requirements.text: Bayside Solutions, Inc. is not able to sponsor any candidates at this time. Additionally, candidates for this position must qualify as a W2 candidate.
Degree in computer science, data science, engineering, quantitative science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Strong Python and SQL skills, including agentic coding tools, with experience designing and maintaining data ingestion, transformation, and management pipelines.
Experience with APIs, typed schemas, automated testing, debugging, and reproducible computational workflows.
Experience managing data quality, provenance, missingness, and consistent identifiers across heterogeneous sources.
Experience with Git-based development, code review, packaging, documentation, and secure handling of internal data.
Basic fluency in machine learning data requirements, with enough chemistry and biology understanding to follow scientific use cases.
Ability to communicate uncertainty and data limitations clearly to colleagues with different scientific and software backgrounds.
Ability to independently execute defined work, meet agreed milestones, incorporate feedback, and collaborate across engineering roles.
Experience with document processing, OCR, or extraction from text, tables, and images, including multimodal model applications.
Experience with Databricks, cloud storage, scalable data processing, or workflow orchestration.
Experience managing scientific datasets in drug discovery, cheminformatics, bioinformatics, or related research.
Experience building benchmark datasets, evaluation infrastructure, or source-grounded validation of extracted information.
Experience using AI-assisted coding tools with code review and testing, or delivering projects in biotechnology or consulting.
